intake.job_description: Backend intern on the payments infrastructure team, working mostly in Go and AWS. You will help maintain services that move money between accounts, fix bugs from the on-call backlog and add small features under a senior engineer.

brief.role_summary: A backend intern on a payments infrastructure team, mostly fixing bugs and making small changes to Go services running on AWS. Much of the day is assigned bug work, so broader infrastructure and design skills are easy to miss.
likely_responsibilities: Fix bugs from the on-call backlog
Add small features to Go services
Read and follow existing deployment and review processes
Pair with a senior engineer on code reviews
tools_and_practices: A CI pipeline for builds and tests
Monitoring and alerting for money-movement services
skill_gaps: Hands-on infrastructure as code is unlikely to be assigned to an intern
CI/CD pipeline design is usually owned by a platform team
System design is learned by reading and writing designs, which interns rarely do
downtime_opportunities: Diagram the services you already touch and how data flows between them
Practise infrastructure as code in a personal sandbox account
Write up an incident or bug you fixed as a short postmortem
cautions: Do not use production data or credentials for practice work
Keep sandbox work in a personal or approved account
Check with your mentor before sharing anything that mentions internal systems

tasks.title: Map the payments deployment pipeline
tasks.objective: Understand how code you touch gets from a pull request to production.
tasks.deliverable: A written walkthrough (outline) of the build, test and deploy stages, with an owner for each stage.

tasks.title: Shadow an incident postmortem
tasks.objective: See how reliability problems are diagnosed and what gets fixed afterwards.
tasks.deliverable: A half-page summary of the incident timeline, root cause and follow-up actions.

tasks.title: Sketch the architecture of one service you work on
tasks.objective: Practise reading a real system and naming its components and failure points.
tasks.deliverable: A written architecture description plus a list of three failure modes and how each is handled.

tasks.title: Write a Terraform module for a staging environment
tasks.objective: Learn infrastructure as code by describing a small cloud environment as code.
tasks.deliverable: A Terraform module in a sandbox account that creates a queue, a function and a storage bucket.

tasks.title: Add a CI workflow with tests and linting to a side repo
tasks.objective: Practise building a pipeline that blocks bad changes before merge.
tasks.deliverable: A repository with a working CI workflow that runs tests and linting on every pull request.

tasks.title: Design a retry-safe money transfer API on paper
tasks.objective: Apply system design thinking to idempotency, retries and consistency.
tasks.deliverable: A two-page design doc with an API sketch, a data model and a failure-handling section.

tasks.title: Add a canary deployment step to your sandbox pipeline
tasks.objective: Combine pipeline and infrastructure skills into a safer release process.
tasks.deliverable: A README and pipeline config (as text) showing a canary release step and the rule that triggers an automatic rollback.

tasks.title: Write up your design doc and pipeline for your mentor
tasks.objective: Turn practice work into a clear written summary you can get feedback on.
tasks.deliverable: A one-page written summary of your design doc and pipeline for your mentor, plus three questions you would ask them.
